Dispute forum is courts, and the Section 8 arbitration is AAA-administered with no foreign seat, so no walk-away trigger (mandatory arbitration seated abroad) applies.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed; the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs.

The rationale correctly notes the law/venue mismatch and the Section 8 / Section 14(a) tension as non-material observations rather than deviations, matching the playbook's instruction to note minor shortfalls in the rationale.
